normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 34W - On the Shore”, a Gulf-front escape in the exclusive High Pointe Resort. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo offers sweeping Gulf views, direct beach access, and all the comforts of home. Perfectly located between Rosemary and Alys Beach, it’s the ideal retreat for couples or families seeking luxury, convenience, and classic 30A vibes. With al fresco balcony dining, a fully equipped kitchen, a lagoon-style pool, and Crabby Steve’s just steps away, your beachfront paradise awaits. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Gulf-Front Location — Direct beachfront access with breathtaking Gulf views from the balconyResort Amenities Galore — Lagoon-style pool, hot tub, on-site tennis & pickleball, and Crabby Steve’s beachfront restaurantBalcony Dining — Enjoy morning coffee or sunset dinners with a front-row seat to the GulfSpacious 2-Bedroom Layout — Sleeps 6 with two private suites and smart open living designFully Equipped Kitchen — Stainless steel appliances, bar seating, and ample storagePrivate Laundry Room — Full-size washer and dryer for your convenience*** LIVING AREA ***Comfortable seating with plush sofa and armchairsFlat-screen TV for movie nights and downtimeGulf-front balcony access with outdoor dining for 4Wall-to-wall windows framing the emerald water views*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Stainless steel appliances and ample cabinet storageBar seating for 4 for casual breakfasts or cocktail hourDining table with seating for 4 for shared mealsOpen-concept design connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary King Suite — King bed, flat-screen TV, direct Gulf-front balcony access, and en-suite bathroom with dual vanities & a walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite — Two queen beds, flat-screen TV, en-suite bathroom with single vanity & shower/tub combo + secondary hallway access*** OUTDOOR SPACES & RESORT AMENITIES ***Gulf-front balcony with dining for 4 and panoramic viewsLagoon-style community pool with waterfall, kiddie pool, and hot tubPrivate beach access via boardwalk steps from your doorOn-site dining at Crabby Steve’s — beachfront, casual, and deliciousTennis courts, 4 pickleball courts, shuffleboard, and a kids’ playgroundBBQ grills (charcoal) and green spaces for family fun*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Peddlers Pavilion — Just across the street! Enjoy live music, food vendors, and shoppingRosemary Beach — 6-minute walk to charming cobblestone streets and boutique cafésAlys Beach — Less than a mile away, known for its serene beauty and striking architectureCarillon Downtown & Market Street — 8-minute drive for additional shopping and dining*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfersBicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***TDT #: 207802
